scope: nenkin primary; only reachable n2framework dependencies; root scope question may steer
initialAnalysisPolicy: Fresh source-only AI analysis for each new document. No cross-document or old-project checkpoint reuse.
revisionPolicy: AI produces full new Markdown; separate AI review. Same-document checkpoint only after raw artifacts, before/after capsule, plan and document identity validation; newly unanalysed dependencies require fresh analysis.
parallelismPolicy: Start bounded independent document waves; two workers initially; adapt toward four only after plan volume and measured stage duration, without dropping source obligations.
requiredEligibility: Root source snapshot/plan SHA plus independent plan review approval before author provider starts.
executionContextNote: Generic document context includes definition and related document index/responsibilities, not external execution-context or plan systemSummary. Keep scope and required responsibilities in document definitions; no core or prompt monkeypatch.
structurePolicy: Latest docs7.2: feature item LIST exact10 columns; event six h4; per-table TABLE9 columns; actual source-derived state differences; readable numbered subflows.
nativePolicy: Text review approval is separate from static-source/native image and HTML/PDF/XLSX checks. Parent handles conversions and publication, including three Excel patterns.
engineeringEvidenceScope: Prior r19 engineering tests are infrastructure evidence only, not new nenkin project qualification.
